answer: Reputation must be bought with work, not wallets. Each new identity starts as a pearl: a small locked stake, one attestation slot. Rank rises only by answering randomized liveness probes from attested peers; misses burn stake. Influence grows with the square root of bonded capital, so a sybil trying to forge a fleet of cheap pearl accounts pays n deposits plus constant staffing yet earns less weight than one honest node with the same total. Veterans may jade-stamp a newcomer by co-signing early probes, but that vouch is slashable if the fake is exposed. Cost scales linearly; payoff does not.
